title: Give every hx-swap-oob element the id it swaps into

facts.note: Markup-producing files where htmx attributes can appear.
Workspace-wide scan: covers pre-existing violations as well as new ones, independent of what the diff touched.

values: any edit to markup containing an hx-swap-oob element (including edits that only add/remove/move an id)
facts.note: Optional diff-level observer for early firing; not required for scope — the rule applies to every hx-swap-oob element present, changed or not.

fires: A response fragment contains an element with hx-swap-oob="true" and only a class attribute, no id.
An hx-swap-oob element's id sits on a wrapper element rather than on the element carrying hx-swap-oob.
An edit removes or moves the id of an existing oob element while the hx-swap-oob attribute itself is unchanged.
A pre-existing hx-swap-oob element without an id is present in the workspace, even if untouched by the current diff.
doesNotFire: An element uses in-band hx-swap with hx-target (selector-based, not id-based).
An hx-swap-oob element carries a JSX expression id such as id={rowId}.
An hx-swap-oob element carries a literal id="…" on its own opening tag.

given: Markup contains an element marked hx-swap-oob — an out-of-band fragment updating a region other than the requesting element's target (badge, flash region, count).
when: Any such element exists in the workspace or is written or edited, including edits touching only its id.
then: The element carrying hx-swap-oob MUST itself carry an id (literal id="…" or JSX id={…}) naming the element it replaces.
prefer: Put the id on the oob element itself; htmx reads it from the element carrying the attribute.
Smoke-test that the id matches an element existing in the current document.
avoid: Putting the id on a wrapper.
Debugging server, route or response headers for "returned but page doesn't update" before checking the oob id.
unless: Id supplied as a JSX expression (id={rowId}): binding present; resolution is a runtime concern.
In-band hx-swap: swaps into hx-target, a selector, not an id.
why: htmx matches oob elements to destinations by id; without one it silently drops them — no error, no warning, no swap. The server logs 200 and markup arrives, so this most frequent htmx silent bug sends people debugging code that is not wrong.
evidence: htmx_hypermedia_detector reports no hx-swap-oob element lacking an id on its own opening tag.
Reviewer confirms each hx-swap-oob element carries id="…" or id={…} on the same element, not a wrapper.
A smoke test shows the oob fragment actually updates the page (the id resolves to an existing element) — the static rule cannot see an id that matches nothing.
verifier_detail: Detector: zero-dependency Bun detector (htmx_hypermedia_detector) locates each `hx-swap-oob` occurrence, extracts the enclosing opening tag with a quote-aware scan (a `>` inside an attribute value does not end the tag early), and flags the element when that tag carries no `id="…"` or JSX `id={…}`.
Only the opening tag of the element carrying hx-swap-oob is inspected; an id on an ancestor/wrapper does not satisfy the rule.
JSX expression ids (id={…}) count as present; resolution is not checked.
Ids that match no element in the current document are dropped just as silently by htmx but are NOT detectable by this rule; they require a smoke test.
Disposition: strict (this rule's metadata.disposition; also restated as `strict` in the source fix_hint).
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.
Lineage: Bun/htmx-stack realization of the agnostic "a declarative binding must name its target" obligation, enforced by the htmx_hypermedia_detector family implementation on atdd.workspace.bun.
Summary: an "oob swaps name their destination" obligation.

Term out_of_band_swap: `hx-swap-oob` marks an element in a response for swapping somewhere OTHER than the requesting element's target — the mechanism for updating a cart badge, a flash region or a sidebar count from a response whose main target is elsewhere.

Term silent_discard: htmx's behaviour when no element in the document matches the oob element's id: it drops the fragment and continues. The failure is invisible at every layer — the server logs a 200, the network tab shows the markup arriving, and the page does not change.
Severity 2; disposition strict (fix_hint also ends with "`strict`.").

splitSuggestion.then: Every hx-swap-oob id must match an element that exists in the current document, proven by a smoke test.

additions.text: The requirement that the oob id resolve to an existing element (S025–S026) is a separate obligation this static rule cannot verify; it should be its own convention (coder.htmx.swap-oob-id-resolves) verified by a smoke test. Kept here as prefer[2]/evidence[2]/verifier_detail[4].
additions.justification: One obligation per 'then'; source explicitly says this rule cannot see unresolved ids.

additions.text: fires/doesNotFire scenarios and activation facts are authored from the source statement and exceptions; scope is every hx-swap-oob element, not only diff-touched ones.
additions.justification: Required structure; derived from source content, adds no new obligation.

additions.text: Top-level `disposition` and `severity` fields added to bind identity metadata (strict, 2) to this rule explicitly.
additions.justification: Identity destination must carry the disposition/severity from source metadata; values are from the source, not new.
